delete.description: Delete several applications (?ids=1&ids=2); all of them or none.

schema.title: Response List Applications Api Applications Get

patch.description: Move several applications to one status; all of them or none (unknown ids fail the whole request).

post.description: Create an application with fields filled by hand.

Save a new application with its job posting (text, link or file) right away; the local model fills
in its fields in the background, then (with report) generates its profile match report.
Cancelling the job before it is done deletes the application.

Queue the profile match report of several applications, one job each, in the order given. Applications
without skills (nothing to compare) and those whose report is already queued are skipped.

Fill the application again from a new job posting, or from the saved one. Empty fields are filled
when the job is done; values for filled fields are proposed (accepted with POST /api/jobs/{id}/accept).
Queue the generation (or regeneration) of the profile match report by the local model.

get.description: Backups, newest first, with the schedule and the cleanup rules.

post.description: A manual backup; answers once it is written.

get.description: The archive, streamed from the backup service.

post.description:
Put database and files back as in the backup. The current state is saved first; meanwhile the app is
in maintenance.

get.description: All events except status changes, which belong to the application history.

schema.title: Response List Events Api Events Get

put.description:
Mode, and the hosts of internal mode (custom mode serves the names of its certificates). Caddy picks up
the new configuration within a few seconds. Turning HTTPS on or off ends every session.

get.description:
Certificate of the internal authority, to install on the devices that open the app. Public: it holds no
secret, and a device may need it before anyone can sign in from it.

post.description:
A certificate (PEM, with its intermediate certificates) and its private key, for custom mode. A
certificate for the same names replaces the old one.

get.description: The user's jobs, waiting, running and finished (until dismissed), in order of creation.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

delete.description: Cancel a waiting or running job (an application it is creating is deleted), or dismiss a finished one.

post.description: Apply the values the job proposed for fields that were already filled; the job is then dismissed.
Generate a new downloadable recovery key; the old one stops working.
Set a new password via recovery key; the used key is replaced with a new one.

get.description: Read only: a user who never saved the profile gets an empty one (id null), created by the first write.

put.description: Store the CV and its text; profile fields are filled by hand or via POST /api/profile/fills.

post.description:
Fill the profile from the uploaded CV in the background. Empty fields are filled when the job is
done; values for filled fields are proposed (accepted with POST /api/jobs/{id}/accept).

get.description: Public: whether the admin still needs to be created, plus the password rules.

post.description: Create the first user as admin. Only allowed while no users exist.
Install the newer release of the selected branch, once no AI job of any user is waiting or running.

get.description: Progress only, polled by every user to show the update screen.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get

post.description: The recovery key is returned only once; the admin hands it to the new user.

delete.description: Delete the user along with applications, events, profile and files.
